newsitem.title: UK: Price Waterhouse appointed gov't adviser on 'tube'.
newsitem.headline: Price Waterhouse appointed gov't adviser on 'tube'.

text.p: The UK government has appointed accountants Price Waterhouse to advise it on the range of financial options available to revitalise the London Underground metro system.

The joint transport and environment ministry announced the appointment in a statement on Wednesday. "The work will be taken forward as a matter of urgency and the contract is due to end in October," said the statement.
Price Waterhouse will work alongside government officials. The network known as "the tube" is in desperate need of a cash injection to safeguard its future after recent drastic cuts in its funding.

Labour has rejected a wholesale privatisation of the network. Other options may include the private sector taking a minority stake in the network, offering private franchises to operate lines or setting up private/public partnerships schemes.
